children: RNS Number : 5442T  Savannah Energy Plc  04 September 2026

Savannah Energy PLC, the British independent energy company focused around the delivery of Projects that Matter, announces that it has been notified of a transfer of 128,550,000 Ordinary Shares in the Company (the "Ordinary Shares"), between companies beneficially owned by Andrew Knott, Chief Executive Officer and a Director of the Company. Accordingly, there has been no change in Andrew Knott's beneficial ownership of the Ordinary Shares of the Company, which remains at 20.2%. The transfer has been undertaken to consolidate Andrew Knott's shareholdings in the Company into his personal name and a single company beneficially owned by him.
The information contained in this notification is disclosed in accordance with the requirements of Article 19 of the Market Abuse Regulation.
